# invoice status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:invoiceStatus`](gmeow-invoiceStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/invoiceStatus>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

The status of an invoice, drawn from the open [`InvoiceStatus`](../classes/gmeow-InvoiceStatus.md) value vocabulary. Non-functional: an invoice may progress through several statuses over time.
